name: Spider Plant
hook: A pet-safe plant that makes free baby plants for you.

steps.title: Bright, indirect light
steps.tip: Bright, indirect light suits it best; hot midday sun can scorch the leaves.

steps.title: Keep it evenly moist
steps.tip: Water when the top 2–3 cm is dry. It hates sitting in water or drying out completely.

steps.title: Brown tips? Try rainwater
steps.tip: Fluoride and salts in tap water burn the tips, so use filtered water or rainwater if you can.

steps.title: Pot up the babies
steps.tip: Set the baby plants in small pots of soil while they're still attached. Snip them off once they root.

steps.title: Repot when roots show
steps.tip: Repot before thick roots crack the pot, going up just a few cm in size.

outro: Pet safe, forgiving, and it multiplies. The perfect starter plant.

sources.title: NC State Plant Toolbox: Chlorophytum comosum
